name: PD 185 was established by Ordinance No. 18480, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 21, 1984. Ordinance No. 18480 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas  City
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 185 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 185 was established by Ordinance No. 18480, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 21, 1984. Ordinance No. 18480 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 185 is established on property generally located at the southeast corner of Mockingbird Lane and Hillside Drive. The size of PD 185 is approximately 1.7959 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-185.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development of the Property must conform to the development plan (Exhibit 185A). (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.105.LANDSCAPE PLAN. The Property must be landscaped in accordance with the landscape plan which is a part of the development plan. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.106.USES. The office building shown on the development plan may be used for any use allowed in an O-2 Office District, except for hotel, motel, and multiple-family uses, which are prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Lighting Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.107.LIGHTING PLAN. All exterior lighting must be in accordance with the lighting plan shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Office Building Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-185.108.OFFICE BUILDING SIZE. The office building shown on the development plan must comply with the following size requirements:
(1)Maximum floor area is 15,400 square feet.
(2)Maximum height is 30 feet.
(3)Maximum number of stories is two. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.109.COVERAGE. Maximum permitted lot coverage is 10 percent. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.110.PAVING. Paving of streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must comply with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.111.BUILDING SETBACKS. All buildings on the Property must be set back as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.112.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII, except for the one detached monumental sign shown on the development plan, which is allowed. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: Creek Maintenance
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.113.CREEK MAINTENANCE. An appropriate device, such as a trash rack, must be installed in the creek at the southern end of the Property to prevent trash and other debris from continuing downstream. The devise must be installed and maintained by the owner, at his own expense. The device must be kept clean and in good operating condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-185.114.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18480; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-185.115.ZONING MAP. PD 185 is located on Zoning Map No. H-8. (Ord Nos. 18480; 25508)
